info.name: Tokyo Vice
info.plot: Un resoconto di prima mano del pestaggio della polizia metropolitana di Tokyo a seguito di Jake Adelstein, un giornalista americano che si infiltra nella squadra di polizia di Tokyo Vice per rivelare la corruzione. Basato sull'omonimo libro di saggistica di Jake Adelstein.

episodes.name: The Test
episodes.plot: Hired as Meicho Shimbun’s first American crime reporter, Jake Adelstein is quickly tasked with covering two cases that initially appear unrelated, but soon stakes his career – and life – on connecting the dots.

translations.value: Hired as Meicho Shimbun’s first American crime reporter, Jake Adelstein is quickly tasked with covering two cases that initially appear unrelated, but soon stakes his career – and life – on connecting the dots.

episodes.name: Kishi Kaisei
episodes.plot: As crime boss Tozawa dangerously toes the line between territories, the rival Chihara-Kai scramble to collect dues. Samantha protects another hostess, while Jake witnesses a confrontation that changes everything.

translations.value: As crime boss Tozawa dangerously toes the line between territories, the rival Chihara-Kai scramble to collect dues. Samantha protects another hostess, while Jake witnesses a confrontation that changes everything.

episodes.name: Read the Air
episodes.plot: Jake’s persistence pays off when he receives an exclusive from Detective Katagiri – but catches the less ideal eye of someone else in the process. Meanwhile, Samantha hits it off with a new customer, as Sato chooses between words and fists.

translations.value: Jake’s persistence pays off when he receives an exclusive from Detective Katagiri – but catches the less ideal eye of someone else in the process. Meanwhile, Samantha hits it off with a new customer, as Sato chooses between words and fists.

episodes.name: I Want It That Way
episodes.plot: As Samantha makes strides toward the future, her past catches up. With help from Emi, Tin-Tin, and Trendy, Jake has a breakthrough in connecting the cases - and comes face-to-face with the head of Chihari-Kai, who requires a favor.

translations.value: As Samantha makes strides toward the future, her past catches up. With help from Emi, Tin-Tin, and Trendy, Jake has a breakthrough in connecting the cases - and comes face-to-face with the head of Chihari-Kai, who requires a favor.

episodes.name: Everybody Pays
episodes.plot: When Jake helps reveal the mole in Chihara-Kai, he must weigh the risks of accepting a favor in return from Ishida. Samantha attempts to take care of her Matsuo problem. Sato’s recruitment ends with a devastating lesson in loyalty.

translations.value: When Jake helps reveal the mole in Chihara-Kai, he must weigh the risks of accepting a favor in return from Ishida. Samantha attempts to take care of her Matsuo problem. Sato’s recruitment ends with a devastating lesson in loyalty.

episodes.name: The Information Business
episodes.plot: An impromptu Yakuza Peace Summit finds Tozawa at the mercy of his own actions. Samantha begins to settle her debts with Matsuo. A determined Jake chases down a tip from Ishida.

translations.value: An impromptu Yakuza Peace Summit finds Tozawa at the mercy of his own actions. Samantha begins to settle her debts with Matsuo. A determined Jake chases down a tip from Ishida.

episodes.name: Sometimes They Disappear
episodes.plot: Jake struggles to regain his footing after the botched raid, while Samantha grows increasingly desperate to find Polina. Sato feels the pressure of his elevated standing in Chihari-Kai.

translations.value: Jake struggles to regain his footing after the botched raid, while Samantha grows increasingly desperate to find Polina. Sato feels the pressure of his elevated standing in Chihari-Kai.

episodes.name: Yoshino
episodes.plot: While Samantha risks it all for Polina’s safe return, Sato is forced to mix business with pleasure. As Katagiri devises a plan to finally take down Tozawa, Jake is confronted by the crime boss’s men.

overview.value: Liberamente ispirato al racconto diretto di Jake Adelstein, la serie criminale racconta di un giovane giornalista americano e della sua ascesa nelle viscere al neon della Tokyo di fine anni '90, dove niente e nessuno è come sembra.

tagline.value: Find the truth, no matter the cost.

translations.overview: Liberamente ispirato al racconto diretto di Jake Adelstein, la serie criminale racconta di un giovane giornalista americano e della sua ascesa nelle viscere al neon della Tokyo di fine anni '90, dove niente e nessuno è come sembra.

A first-hand account of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police beat following Jake Adelstein, an American journalist who embeds himself into the Tokyo Vice police squad to reveal corruption. Based on Jake Adelstein’s non-fiction book of the same name.
translations.tagline: Find the truth, no matter the cost.
